OpenAI → Hugging Face 攻击事件让人们不禁发问：“我们还需要担心什么？”而Anthropic的过滤器标记出了两个领域：网络安全和生物学。随之而来的自然问题是：那么生物安全呢？Clem Delangue认为，网络战的防御能力需要保持开放，并跟上前沿模型攻击能力的步伐。Radical Numerics联合创始人Eric Nguyen与我们坐下来，解释了为什么那些提升生物能力的模型，同样也能让防御不至于落后。

从零开始构建病毒

podcasts.originalExcerpt: The OpenAI → Hugging Face attack has people asking “what else do we need to worry about?” and Anthropic’s filters flag two things: cyber-security and biology. The natural question is: what about bio-security, then? Clem Delangue argues that cyber-warfare defensive capabilities need to be open and to keep pace with frontier models’ attack capabilitiesRadical Numerics co-founder Eric Nguyen sat down with us and explained why the same models that increase biological capability can also keep defense from falling behind.Building a virus from scratchWhile he was at Stanford, Eric couldn’t get traction on Genomic Language Models (GLMs) for a long time. Biologists didn’t believe it would work, didn’t think they could verify the output, and didn’t see important applications beyond what they could already do.
